definitions.explanation: An exciting or daring experience, typically involving some risk or uncertainty.
Taking a chance on something uncertain or dangerous.

examples.japanese: {冒険|ぼうけん}に{出|で}かけよう！
{子供|こども}のころ{冒険|ぼうけん}{物語|ものがたり}が{大好|だいす}きだった。
examples.english: I loved adventure stories when I was a child.

examples.japanese: {未知|みち}の{世界|せかい}への{冒険|ぼうけん}に{出|で}かける。
examples.english: To set out on an adventure to an unknown world.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{冒険|ぼうけん}{家|か}として{世界|せかい}{中|じゅう}を{旅|たび}して、たくさんの{経験|けいけん}をした。
examples.english: As an adventurer, he traveled around the world and had many experiences.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}たちは{冒険|ぼうけん}{心|しん}いっぱいで、{近|ちか}くの{山|やま}を{探検|たんけん}して{遊|あそ}んでいた。
examples.english: The children, full of adventurous spirit, were playing by exploring the nearby mountain.

examples.japanese: その{投資|とうし}は{冒険|ぼうけん}だと{思|おも}う。
examples.english: I think that investment is a risk.

examples.japanese: {今|いま}の{仕事|しごと}を{辞|や}めるのは{冒険|ぼうけん}だが、{挑戦|ちょうせん}してみたい。
examples.english: Quitting my current job is a risk, but I want to give it a try.

examples.japanese: {経験|けいけん}のない{分野|ぶんや}で{起業|きぎょう}するのは{大|おお}きな{冒険|ぼうけん}だが、{成功|せいこう}すれば{大|おお}きな{利益|りえき}が{得|え}られる。
examples.english: Starting a business in an unfamiliar field is a big risk, but if successful, great profits can be gained.

examples.japanese: {人生|じんせい}で{一度|いちど}も{冒険|ぼうけん}しなかったことを{後悔|こうかい}するより、{失敗|しっぱい}しても{冒険|ぼうけん}したほうがいい。
examples.english: It's better to take a risk and fail than to regret never having ventured anything in life.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいことに{挑戦|ちょうせん}するのは{冒険|ぼうけん}だけど、そこから{学|まな}ぶことも{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Trying new things is a risk, but there is also much to learn from it.

notes:
USAGE: {冒険|ぼうけん} can refer to thrilling adventures or to taking risks in business/life.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{冒険|ぼうけん}する (to venture, to take a risk)
・{冒険|ぼうけん}に{出|で}る (to set out on an adventure)
・{冒険|ぼうけん}{心|しん} (adventurous spirit)
・{大|だい}{冒険|ぼうけん} (great adventure)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{冒険|ぼうけん}{家|か} (adventurer)
・{冒険|ぼうけん}{小説|しょうせつ} (adventure novel)
・{冒険|ぼうけん}{心|しん} (adventurous spirit)
・{冒険|ぼうけん}{的|てき} (adventurous, risky)
